best_idea: A zone load is a queue of registered tasks, each one a resumable step that gets the slice end, so the frame stays under budget and the progress bar only moves forward.
decision_why: Take the queue, the admission rule and the resume-at-front rule; change the donor's per-task 200 ms window to the slice end and replace one-machine estimates with measured averages, because the zone loader must respect the frame budget.
acceptance: While a zone loads, no task runs past its slice end (a fake-clock test fails if any run returns after sliceEndsAt), and the progress bar never goes backwards.
